name: Verdion Prediction Market Resolution Rules
description: Rules governing the resolution, challenge, and voiding of legal evaluation forecast markets (§10.5)

benchmark_evaluation.procedure: An authorized independent evaluator evaluates whether a specified compliance gap exists according to the pre-frozen benchmark rubric and test scenario facts.
benchmark_evaluation.ambiguity_handling: If facts are insufficient or contradictory authorities remain unharmonized by published case law, evaluator must designate VOID / UNRESOLVED rather than forcing a speculative binary outcome.

settlement_rules.payout_metric: Brier Score Proper Scoring Rule BS = (1/N) * sum((p_i - y_i)^2)
settlement_rules.credit_distribution: Deterministic reward pool distributed proportionally to inverse Brier score variance among revealed participants.
settlement_rules.dust_remainder_handling: Integer division dust remainder (totalRewardPool % n) is computed as (totalRewardPool - perAgentReward * n) and tracked explicitly in the named contract storage field Market.dustRemainder, guaranteeing strict conservation of simulated credits (totalPaidOut + dustRemainder == fundedAmount). dustRemainder is intentionally not distributed in the MVP and stays in the market contract.
settlement_rules.unrevealed_penalty: Agents who commit but fail to reveal forfeit their commitment deposit.

void_conditions: Benchmark rubric deemed corrupted or inconsistent prior to reveal window
Less than minimum required sample size (N < 2 revealed forecasts)
Evaluation scenario invalidated by conflicting authoritative guidance issued before assessment date
